beats.care: Heading out on Navami? Note the exits when you enter, avoid packed lanes with stalls, and keep friends in sight.
beats.what: West Bengal Fire and Emergency Services sent notices to Chetla Agrani, Ballygunge Cultural Association and Tridhara Sammilani over safety gaps.
beats.why: After 19 people died at Chorbagan, officials are checking crowded pandals. They found risky stalls, dim lighting and poor ventilation.

cards.body: Temporary stalls near pandals, LPG cylinders close to flammable material, dark spots from weak lighting, and poor airflow inside. Officials ordered risky stalls removed at once.
cards.title: What inspectors found

cards.body: Tridhara Sammilani says it had a fire NOC and sent a compliance report. Ballygunge Cultural Association says it has improved lighting and cleared entry routes.
cards.title: What committees say

opts: It hides dark spots that make crowd control harder
It breaks Puja rules on colour
cards.q: Why did fire officials worry about dim lighting?
cards.why: Officials said poor lighting created dark spots that hampered visibility and crowd management.

cards.q: Do you check exits at a pandal?

hook: Which *big south Kolkata pandals* got fire safety notices?

learn.t: Fire officials flagged poor lighting as a crowd risk: dark spots make it harder to see and guide crowds.

tldr: Bengal's fire services sent safety notices to three big south Kolkata Puja committees during checks that followed the Chorbagan crush.
watch: The state will meet Puja committees at a Bijoya Sammelani on October 26 to discuss preventing such tragedies.
